name: Brave Paradise
source:
Follow Emilio, a contestant on the brand new show, "Brave Paradise". 8 contestants will participate in a variety of challenges on a remote island that will test their strength, wit, and courage. Can you gather enough quest medals to win? Will you fall in love on this island getaway? You only have two weeks to make a good impression, so let the games begin!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230902080645/https://daizfrg.itch.io/brave-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随埃米利奥的脚步，他是全新真人秀“Brave Paradise”的参赛者。八名选手将在一座偏远岛屿上参加各式挑战，考验他们的力量、机智和勇气。你能收集足够的任务奖章赢得比赛吗？能否在这场海岛度假中邂逅爱情？你只有两周时间留下好印象，游戏开始！

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230902080645/https://daizfrg.itch.io/brave-paradise]Itch.io[/url]]
